questions.def: «Design» — kiyimning uslubi va bichimini oʻylab chizmoq; tikish boshqaga qoladi.
questions.question: She likes to ___ her own clothes: she draws the style first and a tailor sews them.

questions.def: «Style» va «fashion» — moda, kiyinish uslubi maʼnosida bir-birini almashtiradi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for style?

questions.def: «Modern» — zamonaviy; teskarisi «old-fashioned», yaʼni eski modadagi.
questions.question: What is the opposite of modern?

questions.def: «Pattern» — yuzada takrorlanib turadigan naqsh, yaʼni takrorlanuvchi dizayn.
questions.question: What does pattern mean?

questions.def: «Paint a picture» — boʻyoq bilan rasm ishlamoq; moʻyqalam shuni koʻrsatadi.
questions.question: ___ a picture with oil paints on a large canvas

questions.def: «Cut» — koʻylakning bichimi; tana chizigʻiga qanday oʻtirishini bichim belgilaydi.
questions.question: The ___ of the dress is very elegant; it follows the line of the body perfectly.

questions.def: «Create» — yaratmoq, yasamoq; «make» bilan bir xil maʼno beradi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for create?

questions.def: «Bright» — yorqin; teskarisi «dull», yaʼni xira va zerikarli.
questions.question: What is the opposite of bright?

questions.def: «Artwork» — sanʼat asari, rassom yaratgan ish.
questions.question: What does artwork mean?

questions.def: «Pose a model» — modelni surat uchun maʼlum holatda turgʻizmoq.
questions.question: The photographer needs to ___ a model carefully before taking each photo.

questions.def: «Talent» — tugʻma qobiliyat; «natural ability» aynan shuni bildiradi.
questions.question: This artist is famous for his ___ — few painters have such natural ability.

questions.def: «Sketch» — tez chizilgan chizma, yaʼni «drawing».
questions.question: What is a synonym for sketch?

questions.def: «Simple» — oddiy; teskarisi «complex», yaʼni murakkab.
questions.question: What is the opposite of simple?

questions.def: «Gallery» — sanʼat asarlari namoyish etiladigan joy.
questions.question: What does gallery mean?

questions.def: «Create a design» — yangi dizayn oʻylab topmoq; qalam bilan ish boshlanadi.
questions.question: She sat down with a pencil to ___ a design for the new dress.

questions.def: «Frame» — rasm soliniladigan ramka; devorga ilish uchun aynan ramka kerak.
questions.question: She bought a new ___ so that she could hang her painting on the wall.

questions.def: «Clothing» — kiyim-kechak; rasmiy uslubda «apparel» deyiladi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for clothing?

questions.def: «Expensive» — qimmat; teskarisi «cheap», yaʼni arzon.
questions.question: What is the opposite of expensive?

questions.def: «Collection» — bir joyga toʻplangan narsalar guruhi.
questions.question: What does collection mean?

questions.def: «Organize a show» — koʻrgazmani tashkil qilmoq; joy va model shu ishga kiradi.
questions.question: ___ a show: book the venue, invite the models and plan the music.

questions.def: «Shape» — haykalning shakli; toʻlqinga oʻxshab egilishi shaklga tegishli.
questions.question: The ___ of the sculpture was amazing — it curved like a wave.

questions.def: «Fabric» — mato, yaʼni kiyim tikiladigan «material».
questions.question: What is a synonym for fabric?

questions.def: «Rough» — gʻadir-budir; teskarisi «smooth», yaʼni silliq.
questions.question: What is the opposite of rough?

questions.def: «Artist» — ijod qiluvchi, yangi narsa yaratadigan inson.
questions.question: What does artist mean?

questions.def: «Take a picture» — suratga olmoq; kamera bilan rasm olish aynan shu ibora.
questions.question: ___ a picture of us with your phone camera

questions.def: «Colors» — ranglar; «were» koʻplik boʻlgani uchun faqat koʻplik mos keladi.
questions.question: The ___ of the painting were very vibrant.

questions.def: «Decorate» — bezatmoq; kitobiy sinonimi «embellish».
questions.question: What is a synonym for decorate?

questions.def: «Short» — qisqa; teskarisi «long», yaʼni uzun.
questions.question: What is the opposite of short?

questions.def: «Studio» — rassom ishlaydigan ustaxona.
questions.question: What does studio mean?

questions.def: «Wear a dress» — koʻylak kiymoq; bazmga kiyib borish shu feʼl bilan.
questions.question: She decided to ___ a long black dress to the party.
